source: ClinicalTrials.gov (U.S. National Library of Medicine), Data API v2
reference_period: results first posted 2020-01-01 to 2026-09-30 (registry posting date, not study completion)
mutable_source_note: Registry records change over time. The raw pages saved here, with their SHA-256 hashes, are the snapshot. Re-running the queries later returns the registry as it is then, not this snapshot.

terms_of_use.summary: Data are available at no charge; downloading indicates acceptance of the terms. Publications or redistributions should attribute the source as ClinicalTrials.gov, keep data current, display the date the data were processed by ClinicalTrials.gov, and state any modifications with a complete description. No warranty is given by NLM, NIH or HHS. Some content may be subject to third-party copyright outside the United States.
how_this_project_complies: Source attributed as ClinicalTrials.gov (U.S. National Library of Medicine) in the report, page, README and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
The data are a dated snapshot, not kept current; the API version, data timestamp and retrieval time are shown wherever results are reported.

Every modification (restructuring into tables, parsed numeric columns, derived tiers and checks, excluded point-of-contact block) is described in docs/rules.md, docs/data_dictionary.csv and the methods.
Raw records are not redistributed in the public archive; source_manifest.json identifies them by URL and SHA-256.
